observations: Photo 0: Front view of a white and silver gas cooker with an oven. The brand 'Scanfrost' is visible on the top left. There are five control knobs. The oven door is black glass, showing some smudges and dirt. The unit has black feet and is placed on a wooden floor against a tiled wall.

Photo 1: The oven door is open, revealing two metal racks inside. The interior is dark and appears greasy or stained. The bottom tray is visible and also shows signs of use. The control panel is the same as in photo 0.

Photo 2: Side and top view of the cooker. The glass top cover is present, with a blue 'Scanfrost 35 years of precision' sticker in the center. Four burners are visible under the glass. The side panel is silver with vertical ridges. The unit appears worn, with visible rust and dirt on the edges and body.

claims.claim: Scanfrost 4-burner gas cooker with an integrated oven and glass top cover
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand 'Scanfrost' and the oven. Photo 2 shows the 4 burners and the glass top cover. Photo 1 confirms the integrated oven.

Close-up photos of the interior oven walls and gas burners.
